model.title: Emergency Savings Enhancement Act of 2025
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Todd Young (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would modify rules for pension-linked emergency savings accounts, which allow workers to set aside money for unexpected expenses while saving for retirement. It seeks to change who can open these accounts and how much people are allowed to contribute to them.
